MEET THE FOUNDER

Laura Amato-Yarbrough: Engineer, Educator, Founder

The story behind All Inclusive Tutoring Solutions LLC — and why a systems engineering background changes the way a tutor teaches.

M.S. Systems Engineering, Johns Hopkins Ph.D. Candidate, Industrial & Systems Engineering AZ Certified Substitute
Quick Summary

Laura Amato-Yarbrough is the founder of All Inclusive Tutoring Solutions LLC, holding graduate degrees in systems engineering and education.

From Systems Engineering to the Classroom

Laura's background combines education, healthcare systems engineering, and educational technology. She holds a Master's degree in Systems Engineering from Johns Hopkins University and is currently completing a Ph.D. in Industrial and Systems Engineering at Mississippi State University, alongside a concurrent Doctorate in Education at Johns Hopkins University. That systems-thinking lens shapes every session — helping students recognize patterns, understand how ideas connect, and grow into confident, independent problem-solvers.

What Drives Her Teaching Approach

  • Highly interactive, personalized sessions — not lecture-style tutoring
  • Guiding students with questions, visuals, and multiple strategies
  • Teaching students why a method works, not just what to do
  • A particular strength working with gifted and neurodiverse learners
  • A genuine interest in understanding what makes each student tick

Why She Started All Inclusive Tutoring

All Inclusive Tutoring Solutions LLC grew out of a simple belief: every student deserves an educator who can meet them where they are, whether that's a gifted learner who needs more challenge, a neurodivergent student who needs a different approach, or a family navigating ESA funding for the first time. Sessions are fully virtual, so that reach isn't limited by geography.
